MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 12.5
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 6

2. Solve for x: x + 9 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 9
   C. 13
   D. 4

3. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 6x

4. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 4

5. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 28
   B. 14
   C. 33
   D. 22

6. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 144
   C. 48
   D. 24

7. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 2.5
   B. 0.205
   C. 0.25
   D. 0.025

8. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/4
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 1/2

9. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 26

10. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 31
   C. 43
   D. 49

11. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 10

12. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 50
   C. 14
   D. 7

13. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 13
   C. 26
   D. 170

14. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 27 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

15. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 14
   C. 49
   D. 2

16. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 1
   D. 2

17. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 2/3
   C. 1/4
   D. 1/2

18. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 36
   C. 18
   D. 81

19. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 11
   C. 121
   D. 122

20. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 19
   C. 25
   D. 19.6

21. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 4
   C. 32
   D. 12

22. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.7
   C. 31
   D. 31.6

23. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 72
   B. 17
   C. 73
   D. 1

24. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 45
   C. 18
   D. 36

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
